provenance.reproduction: Source-pinned independent local re-computation and GitHub Actions original-source workflow produce identical estimates at numerical precision (rounded differences <1e-12).

design.response: Breeding observed during at least one ASI visit within that site×species×season; non-detection is NOT true absence
design.contrast: Non-largest SCAR land feature vs largest continuous land source polygon; NOT verified physical ocean island
design.formula: breeding_confirmed ~ separate_source_polygon + C(species) + C(spatial_block_100km) + log2_visits + year_decades
design.variance: clustered sandwich at ASI site code (not at six 100km spatial blocks)
design.timing: Post-source exploratory after 0/1/2 field state and geo class support inspected; not preregistered

claim_ceiling: This model assesses observed breeding-detection odds only; site history and detection probability are not modeled explicitly.
Map source feature is not independently validated physical island or mainland.
Six spatial blocks are too few for reliable block-level inference; site robust CI may be optimistic.
Non-significance does not establish island/mainland equivalence, presence or absence of mammalian predator effects, or continental island convergence.
No glacial retreat effect or first colonization event identified.
Results are exploratory and must not replace frozen Paper 1/Paper 2.
